description: This file defines the CKEditor5Plugin attribute class for Drupal, which manages plugin definitions and aspects for CKEditor 5 integration, including validation and construction logic.

classes.name: CKEditor5Plugin
classes.description: Defines the CKEditor5Plugin attribute class for managing CKEditor 5 plugin definitions within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CKEditor5Plugin attribute, validating and setting aspects of the plugin definition.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the Drupal aspects of the plugin.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets the class name for the Drupal aspects of the plugin.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CKEditor5PluginDefinition object representing the plugin's configuration.
